''See also: [[Death Icon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Death]] [[Icon]] is a powerful manifestation that emerged when the creator of the world's most lethal weaponry underwent a process of killing and reviving himself. It is visually represented as a large symbol featuring a scythe positioned above the Arelius crest{{!}}Arelius family crest, resembling a crescent moon. This [[Icon]] is associated with death-madra{{!}}death madra, which possesses a pale, spectral green glow and can interact with other objects, such as weaving around a trident. The [[Icon]] is linked to the mark of the [[Dreadgods]] and shares a resonant tone with the [[Void Icon]]. It can be commanded to descend upon targets and has been observed communicating through a soft song. Furthermore, the presence of the [[Death]] [[Icon]] is connected to the process of elevating an individual to the rank of [[Monarch]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Upon [[Yerin]]'s command, the [[Death]] [[Icon]] descended upon [[Akura Malice]]. This entity began the process of raising [[Yerin]] to the status of [[Monarch]] while exerting influence over the [[Endless Sword]] [[technique]]. The icon further demonstrated its power by resonating with the [[Final Sword]] [[technique]] and achieving [[resonance]] with the [[Void Icon]]. Ultimately, the [[Death]] [[Icon]] provided support to [[Yerin]] and whispered a soft song to her.}}
